# Vue + Inertia Frontend Conventions

Stack: Vue 3 (`<script setup lang="ts">`), Inertia, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, reka-ui, Lucide icons, ESLint + Prettier.

## Components & pages
- Author SFCs with `<script setup lang="ts">`. Type props via `defineProps<{ ... }>()`.
- Inertia pages live in `resources/js/pages/` and are matched by the string passed to `Inertia::render(...)` on the backend.
- Reusable components live in `resources/js/components/` (shared UI primitives under `components/ui/`).

## Imports
- Use the `@/` alias for everything under `resources/js/` (e.g. `@/components/...`, `@/types`, `@/routes`).
- Use `import type { ... }` for type-only imports (enforced: `consistent-type-imports`, top-level type specifiers). Do not inline `type` on named specifiers.
- Keep imports ordered and alphabetized within groups (builtin → external → internal → parent → sibling → index); ESLint autofix handles this.

## Routes (Wayfinder)
- Import typed route/action helpers from `@/routes` and `@/actions` instead of hardcoding URL strings. These files are generated by Laravel Wayfinder — never edit generated files under `resources/js/routes`, `resources/js/actions`, or `resources/js/wayfinder` by hand.

## Types & i18n
- Shared types live in `@/types`; add to that barrel rather than redefining shapes locally.
- Bilingual content carries `en` (English) and `dv` (Dhivehi) fields — handle both when rendering.

## Styling
- Use Tailwind utility classes; class ordering is handled by `prettier-plugin-tailwindcss`. Prefer existing design tokens/utilities (e.g. `border-sidebar-border`, dark: variants).

## Quality gates (run before considering work done)
- `npm run lint` (ESLint autofix) and `npm run format` (Prettier).
- `npm run types:check` (`vue-tsc --noEmit`) — must pass with no new errors.
- Note stylistic rules: blank lines are required around control statements (`if`, `for`, `return`, etc.) and `1tbs` brace style — let ESLint autofix apply these.
